note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): BCEL, the Lao Development Bank and the Agricultural Promotion Bank; only BCEL's schedule, already found, was read again this time, for want of the research's budget. BCEL's (Banque pour le Commerce Extérieur Lao) international debit and credit card service fees (the schedule made 26 June 2026, as read on 2026-10-29), read in full again on 2026-10-30: its Visa Gold and Visa Classic credit cards, in US dollars, are written with their registration fee for the primary card (30 and 20 dollars), paid on application and written as the issue fee, and their annual fee (40 and 30); an approval fee of 0.5% of the approved amount on a card with no collateral, written as a limit fee at issue (the same 0.5% at each renewal of the card, which isn't yearly, isn't written); 16% a year on a balance carried (with a minimum of 1 dollar, not modelled); a minimum due of 10% of the amount used; a late fee of 2% of the minimum due, at least 5 dollars; a cash withdrawal fee of 0.5 dollars at BCEL's ATMs (3%, at least 3 dollars, elsewhere; not written); and a 2% fee on the exchange-rate difference, written as the foreign transaction share. A card guaranteed by BCEL deposits pays no approval fee, a condition the game doesn't check.
